text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
My skin seems to be missing some<n>of its usual
luster.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Let me think... It must have been from<n>last night.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
El was so enthusiastic about that<n>ultra-hot sauce, I
ended up sampling it<n>despite myself...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: But it was far spicier than I imagined.Sigh... I should be more wary of tryingthings outside of my comfort zone.
